reuse.why: Introduces one shared predicate (shouldWriteMonthBudget) and sign helper used by every month-wide action and setNMonthAvg, and reuses the tree's extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag.

duplication.why: The category query with the notes join and the has_saved_template SQL expression is repeated in getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg instead of one shared selection.

placement.why: The rule lives in a dedicated server/budget/month-action.ts beside the actions, though the saved-template part of the rule is decided in each action's SQL rather than in that module.

scope.why: All edits serve the refactor and the three follow-up features; no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: Changing the hidden/fixed/income logic is a single edit, but changing what counts as a saved template or how group notes are fetched means editing six SQL copies kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action routes its decision through shouldWriteMonthBudget; no pre-existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The category-selection SQL is reshaped per site (setZero aliases c.id AS category and adds 0 AS amount, getBudgetData selects from the budget table, the average actions select c.*), hiding that it is the same query.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget gained includeHiddenCategories; the saved-template and group-notes inputs it decides on are computed by each of the six call sites' own SQL rather than by a shared selection.
